context: M22 o10. (Nick.) The Pennsylvania lobby at midnight. Men in clusters. Lisle working them like a host.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: Varelas. Your lawyer's selling lifeboats. You got a seat?

lines.speaker: char.ray_bauer
lines.text: Mr. Varelas! Ray Bauer. Legit. Very legit. Is the deal still on? Is anything on?

lines.speaker: char.nora_finch
lines.text: Nora Finch, Evening paper. City's broke and somebody's buying hotels. You?

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Everyone's selling everyone. And my name is the merchandise.
